witness_id.description: Stable identifier for this witness (used by policies and receipts).

class.description: Stakeholder class label used by the witness policy (e.g., civil_society, academic, court, party, vendor).

public_key_ref.description: Stable reference to witness signing key material (e.g., did:key, JWK thumbprint URI). Prefer references over inline key blobs.

public_key_pem.description: Optional inline public key material (PEM). Non-normative; prefer public_key_ref.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction label for diversity accounting (best effort).
